about_the_game:
FACE YOUR FEARS

Inspired by old school FPS games with a modern touch added to it, Bloodfire let's you experience the layers of hell in the most brutal, gory and satisfying way possible.

YOU WILL DIE

Kill. Die. Repeat.

Bunnyhop, dash and parry through an endless legion of hellspawn, all inspired by old paintings and novels. From demonic centipedes to bloodthirsty maggots, your skills will be tested to the extreme. Choose from seven unsettling arenas, all with unique play styles and mechanics.

Can you cross the layers of hell and prove yourself worthy?

COMPETE

In global leaderboards, or show off to your friends. Become hell's champion!

GAMEPLAY

Weave through countless enemies with a fluid and expanding movement system, with 3D positional audio, so that you know exactly where your next target is. Go through all the seven layers of hell, complete with unique enemies and movesets, and survive for as long as you can.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains over the top violence and gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible, surround sound support recommended
  • VR Support: None

short_description: A fast paced, old school arena shooter with satisfying movement and precise gunplay. Fight through endless legions of demons and become the undisputed champion of hell.
